name: Ófalu (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a white triangle at the hoist whose point reaches the fly, charged with the municipal arms of Ófalu (a green shield with a yellow well-sweep, with red and blue mantling and a scroll) in the triangle.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ófalu arms with mantling and scroll
